verdict.rationale: Daytona has no native natural-language interface of its own. It does ship a first-party MCP server that lets AI agents such as Claude, Cursor and Windsurf drive sandboxes, plus an official agent skill covering its API, CLI and SDKs, so users can operate it through natural language in an external agent. The docs do not show which operations the MCP server exposes or how complete that coverage is, and no hands-on or independent report confirms the experience works. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which operations are reachable via MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
